counting-and-digit-patterns.title: Counting and Digit Patterns
counting-and-digit-patterns.frontmatter: part-style, like content/lessons/mathematics/arithmetic-number-sense/least-common-multiple.md: part: 1, partCount: 1, ordering: 42, keyPoints (3 to 4)
counting-and-digit-patterns.methods: units-digit cycles of powers (find the cycle, use the remainder); counting all squares of every size in an n by n grid (sum of squares) and in a figure; growing patterns, such as the border tiles of a growing square (find the rule, then the nth figure); smallest or largest difference or sum of numbers formed from given digits

practical-measurement.title: Practical Measurement
practical-measurement.methods: edge of a cube from its volume (cube roots of perfect cubes); area of a polygon on a dot or square grid by counting, splitting and the surrounding-rectangle method; how many whole rectangles can be cut from a sheet (try both orientations, whole numbers only); tiles to cover a floor with unit conversion (convert first); distance traveled by the tip of a turning hand or the edge of a wheel (circumference times turns); area inside margins (subtract twice the margin from each side)

clock-time-and-time-differences.title: Clock Time and Time Differences

clock-time-and-time-differences.methods: 12-hour and 24-hour time; elapsed time, including across noon and midnight (count to the next hour, then whole hours, then minutes; borrowing 60 minutes); adding a duration to a start time; time-zone differences given as an offset (earlier or later, crossing midnight)
